title: My Love
desc: Raj, a man from a wealthy family, decides if he should marry the daughter of his father's best friend or follows the path of his true love.

title: Phool Aur Angaar
desc: A young man rescues a woman from being molested but gets accused of the heinous crime instead. Trying to apprehend the miscreants, he gets caught in a web of deception and lies.

title: Hariyali Aur Rasta
desc: A man's marriage is fixed from his childhood, but he falls for another woman. Though he marries his elders' choice, the ill-fitting union is thrown into disarray when the man's old flame re-enters his life.

title: Kirayadar
desc: Laxmi Abhyankar and her employed daughter Jaya live on rent in a flat on Pali Hill, Mumbai they rented years ago from Lucknow-based Kundanlal Choudhury. His son Anil comes to Mumbai and gets a job.

title: Khuddar
desc: Hari is forced to marry Seema, who dislikes his stepbrothers, Govind and Rajesh. When he goes to Mumbai, she displaces them to become beggars. However, destiny reunites them with Hari in a courtroom.
